title: mimo2codex providers.json
description: Declare generic OpenAI-compatible upstreams (lanes). Loaded once at boot; changes require a restart. An optional top-level $schema can point to this local file for editor validation.

codexCatalog.description: Path of the codex model-catalog metadata file (served at GET /model_catalog), relative to the data directory. Default: <dataDir>/codex-catalog.json. Env override: MIMO2CODEX_CODEX_CATALOG.

id.description: Unique provider id. Registry order = priority for bare model names. Also the sole suffix for derived `model@provider-id` aliases.

shortcut.description: CLI/webui short code. Must be unique across all providers including built-ins (mimo / ds). Defaults to id.

baseUrl.description: Upstream OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1 (required).

envKey.description: Name of the environment variable holding this provider's API key (required). <NAME>_BASE_URL overrides baseUrl if set.

defaultModel.description: Fallback model id (required). Used when the client model matches the provider catalog but not a declared model, or when forceDefaultModel is on.

wireApi.description: "chat" (default): translate Codex Responses → Chat Completions. "responses": pipe the Responses payload through unchanged.

forceDefaultModel.description: Rewrite any client model id to defaultModel (open-catalog providers only).

models.description: Declared catalog. Empty/absent = open-catalog passthrough (any model id forwarded verbatim).

aliases.description: Extra client-facing names that route to this model. `model@lane` aliases are derived automatically — hand-write only legacy names.

displayName.description: Picker label; lane-qualified entries get a `· lane` suffix appended.

contextWindow.description: Lane-level context-window override; feeds the codex catalog entry.

maxOutputTokens.description: Lane-level output cap; used by generated Codex config snippets.

note.description: Short access/availability note rendered as a trailing comment in config.toml.

nonStreamingUpstream.description: Ask the upstream for one complete JSON (stream:false) and synthesize the codex-side SSE frames from it. For backends that break under streaming. Cost: no token-by-token output.
